name: idtc-mobile
description: IDTC Mobile - Indonesia Digital Twin Community

scripts.cap:init: cap init IDTC Mobile idtc.mobile --web-dir www
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && cap add ios
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:run: npm run cap:sync && cap run ios
